name: Rear Delt Fly
common_faults: using momentum and swinging the upper body
elbows too straight (increases rotator cuff stress)
not retracting scapulae at the top

substitutions.note: cable version; adds external rotation; better constant tension

resistance_profile: hardest at the top of the arc (90° abduction); minimal resistance at the starting position

provenance.notes: Rear delt is commonly underdeveloped relative to front delt in pressing-dominant programs. Light load, high control. Cable version provides more consistent tension. SFR heuristic.
